metaDescription: Order custom neoprene lanyards for events, trade shows, or employee IDs. Soft, durable material with full-color imprint. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Neoprene lanyards offer a soft, stretch-resistant feel that sets them apart from standard polyester or nylon options. The 3/4" width provides ample space for full-color logo printing, making them ideal for trade shows, employee IDs, or event credentials. Choose neoprene when you want a more comfortable, durable neck strap that won't fray or curl over time.
heroAltText: Custom neoprene lanyards with full-color logo imprint and plastic clamshell attachment
